selection_basis: Selected from the screened eligible unworked set. The ASMFC still identifies SEDAR 58 (2020) as the basis for current stock status. SEDAR 107 is the ongoing 2027 Atlantic Migratory Cobia benchmark; its data workshop material is not a completed production assessment or accepted output. SEDAR 58 co23 is therefore the latest completed production run to curate. It provides catch, recreational age compositions, aggregate headboat CPUE, age-specific biology and reported population and mortality outputs with uncertainty. Preserve commercial length compositions and the aggregate CPUE as distinct data streams; do not describe them as observed catch-at-age or an age-specific index. Source tables have been imported; numerical age-composition cells remain unavailable.
